items.title: Coatue Opened Positions in Intel and Cerebras. Is the AI Chip Trade Broadening Beyond NVIDIA?
items.summary: Coatue Management’s Q2 filing disclosed a new position in Intel and, for the first time, a reportable position in newly public Cerebras. Coatue reported 12,084,027 Intel shares and roughly 7.01 million Cerebras shares at June 30. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) offers manufacturing and established distribution, while Cerebras Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:CBRS) offers a radically different wafer-scale architecture. […]

items.title: Marvell Stock Had A Huge Year And Still Sits Well Below Its High
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 235.9% over the past year, climbing from $62.18 to $208.83. The company kept raising what it expects to sell, and buyers repriced it each time. Then the shares pulled back, and they now sit well below their best.

items.title: How Far AMD Stock Can Swing In Its Calm Case
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) trades at about $456.16, and its option chain has already put numbers on how far the stock can travel from here. Over roughly the next 380 days that chain marks out a band running from $260 to $792.23. The width is what matters if you hold the shares. That is the risk you are carrying, whichever way it breaks.

items.title: Dell’s earning report was bullish for Intel CPU demand, analyst says
items.summary: Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) is the most direct equity expression of the structural shift Chowdhry describes. The firm's $200 price target and a 2031 EPS estimate of $20 rest on three interlocking arguments: rising CPU-to-GPU ratios in AI clusters, x86's entrenched enterprise position, and the architectural advantages of Intel's Clearwater Forest processor.
